lesson: Detached, digest-shaped caller metadata can still describe an impossible revision chain. A standalone transcript must enforce the same bounded correction-chain topology invariants as the strict envelope preflight before producing a structural correlation ID.
guardrail: Before hashing a standalone v0.2 untrusted proof request, reject nonconsecutive sequences, broken predecessor digests, duplicate revision IDs/content digests, unsupported claimed finality labels, and mismatched/non-FINAL terminal revision. Exercise nine direct-call mutations and preserve the valid transcript hash. This remains claim-shape consistency only: no independent authentication, source finality proof, scoring or production authority.
